Fire. Wind. And 3,000 people in one day. 🔥 Acts 2

On the day of Pentecost the disciples were together in one place. “Suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind” (Acts 2:2), and tongues like as of fire sat upon each of them. A crowd from every nation heard them in their own language. Some mocked: “These men are full of new wine.” Then Peter stood up, and “about three thousand souls” were added that same day (Acts 2:41).

Peter denied Jesus three times. Weeks later he preached to thousands. What does that tell you about second chances? 👇

He used a rock as a pillow and woke up at the gate of heaven. 🌌 Genesis 28

Jacob was alone on the road to Haran. He “took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows” (Genesis 28:11). That night he dreamed of a ladder reaching to heaven, angels going up and down, and the Lord saying: “I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest” (Genesis 28:15). He woke up and said: “Surely the Lord is in this place; and I knew it not.”

Where is a place you didn't expect to meet God? 👇

Heading home for Thanksgiving? Pack your faith too. 🚗🦃

5 Bible reminders for the road and the table: pray before you leave, because “The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in” (Psalm 121:8); swap one scroll for one Psalm; at the table be “swift to hear, slow to speak” (James 1:19); say thank you out loud (Psalm 107:1); and keep one chapter a day, even on break.

Which one do you need this week? Comment 1 to 5 👇

He was hunting Christians. Then a light from heaven stopped him. ⚡ Acts 9

Saul was “breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord” (Acts 9:1). On the road to Damascus a light from heaven shined round about him and a voice said: “Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?” Three days blind. Then a scared disciple named Ananias walked in and called him “Brother Saul” (Acts 9:17). Scales fell from his eyes, and straightway he preached Christ.

Nobody is too far gone for Jesus. Who are you praying for right now? 👇

The king hunting him walked into his cave. 🗡️ 1 Samuel 24

King Saul took three thousand chosen men to hunt David. Then Saul walked into the very cave where David was hiding. David's men said: this is your day. David only cut off the skirt of Saul's robe, and even that bothered him: “The Lord forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the Lord's anointed” (1 Samuel 24:6). Saul wept: “Thou art more righteous than I” (1 Samuel 24:17).

Have you ever had the chance to get even and chose not to? 👇
